title: Lumbrokinase-loaded GelMA hydrogels with inflammatory regulatory capacity promote vascularized bone regeneration in critical-sized cranial defects
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28689-28702
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04178C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yao-Wen Zhang, Sheng-Tao Zhao, Yi-Fei Ma, Yi-Hui Pan, Xiang-Zhen Yan
The LK-loaded GelMA hydrogel exhibited a combined capacity for inflammatory regulation and promoting osteogenesis and angiogenesis, demonstrating its potential for clinical translation in the reconstruction of critical-sized bone defects.
